item.title: Re: Attention Staff
item.content:encoded: Pages have been parented and renamed accordingly; I tagged them as supplement because I didn't know what else to do with them, although all have also been tagged with the hidden _image tag, so the tag team must have come along at some point. Not sure how to collapse them like Decibelles recommended, though. That's too much Wikidot wizardry for me.

item.title: Attention Staff
item.content:encoded:
I'll post this here and not on all of the Major Tom supplemental pages: currently the supplement tag can only be applied to pages supplemental to SCP articles. Tales cannot have supplements (or at least, those supplemental pages can't have the supplement tag.)

This means staff will have to either expand the definition and application of the supplement tag or retag all Major Tom's supplemental pages with tale instead.
